# Warning-lane replay fixtures

Offline replay set for the v4 lead decoder (audit item 146). Each case is one provider
answer shape: the output text the model wrote, the citation URLs the provider
returned, and the expected decode. The shapes follow xAI's documented citation
forms (x.com/i/status/ID) against model-written links (x.com/<handle>/status/ID).
No real provider output, account names or private data are stored here. Add cases
from the retained 30-day output table (private) only after removing private text.
